original_target.title: Broken-ray tomography with two smooth convex obstacles

scope_comparison: Survey §2(i) explicitly retains the exact two-smooth-convex-obstacle case with one strictly convex obstacle. The flat-piece counterexample permits both obstacles to be non-strictly convex and therefore does not refute the stated hypotheses. Twisted-ray one-obstacle and V-line vertex-data theorems are different geometries.
